_readme: The hand-built Datadog objects (RC1-378). One entry per object; the file
beside it in dashboards/, monitors/, synthetics/ or slos/ is its export.
Generated objects — the two 'Program KPIs' dashboards, the six KPI
monitors, the seven program SLOs — belong to `python -m kpi.datadog` and
are refused here on purpose: see docs/datadog-as-code.md.
Datadog's own host monitor pack (283790038-45, tag monitor_pack:host) is
installed by the Agent integration, not by us, and is left alone.

dashboards.why: RC1-345 site observability — SLOs, Synthetics, SSL and RUM for hihelloreid.com in one pane

RC1-346 agent fleet — one LLM Observability pane over the fleet's ml_apps (eight in service, two dormant smoke-test leftovers); roster RC1-406 + RC1-419, cost units RC1-405, scout column dropped RC1-427, reliability group on ml_obs.trace RC1-407
RC1-347 delivery — CI pipelines, deploy events and the DORA group across the four repos
RC1-348 usage & cost — the estate watching its own Datadog bill

RC1-377/411 fleet LLM cost per call — the price signal, production only, warn $0.05 / alert $0.075
RC1-395 PR agent cost per review — p95 over 1d, warn $0.50 / alert $1.00; per review where 318833109 is per call; message re-based on the no-scout pipeline RC1-427
RC1-335 CI pipeline failed — delivery repos
RC1-335/354 production deploy failed — the Fly and Heroku paths

monitors.why: RC1-408 LLM Obs evaluation judge spend — daily ceiling on the judges' own calls, billed to the datadog-llm-obs-evals workspace since 2026-09-12
RC1-415 eval trend page publish heartbeat — agent_evals.scheduled_run.publish_ok from the launchd job; red on a 0 or on 36 h without a point

RC1-443/444 LLM Obs judge verdict — alerts per ml_app and evaluation when an injection judge (pr-review-agent, hihelloreid-chat) or the chat hallucination judge returns a non-pass categorical verdict in 15 min
RC1-456 daily drift run heartbeat — the drift detector emits no metric of its own, so drift-daily.yml reports its own success; backs the freshness SLO, because a CI-pipelines monitor cannot

RC1-456 concert intelligence heartbeat — the n8n workflow reports its own LLM Obs spans on every run including cached ones, so a two-day silence means the scheduled trigger stopped or the published copy broke

RC1-457 PR review agent review errors — any failed review in 15 min, grouped under the agent's catalog entity so the Software Catalog can find it; queried by ml_app because RC1-447's rename stranded the service history

RC1-457 incident summarizer Lambda errors — multi-alert by functionname so the alert names the failing stage of the eight-function chain; service:incident-summarizer comes from the SAM Globals (RC1-411)

RC1-451 cardinality guardrail — billable custom timeseries above 250 (warn 150) against a measured baseline of 27 avg / 81 max over 30d. The lab that set it pushed one metric to 501 series with a single unbounded tag. Cannot name the metric: estimated_usage.metrics.custom.by_metric reports N/A on this account

RC1-451 log ingest guardrail — more than 10,000 ingested events in a day (warn 5,000) against a baseline of ~265/day, 1,231 max. Fires at half the index's 20,000/day cap, because the cap drops logs silently once reached

synthetics.why: RC1-340 browser check — the client-rendered /work page actually renders

slos.why: RC1-342 portfolio availability — 99.9% over 30d, reachable AND rendered
RC1-456 PR review agent reliability — 97% over 30d. Queried by ml_app, not service: RC1-447's rename stranded the history, and the new service name holds 4 traces against ml_app's 1,444
RC1-456 eval trend page freshness — 97% over 30d on monitor 321408173; a heartbeat, because 2 traces in 30d cannot support a ratio
RC1-456 daily drift run freshness — 97% over 30d on monitor 322753565
RC1-456 concert intelligence run freshness — 97% over 30d on monitor 322765258; a heartbeat, because 26 traces in 30d cannot support a ratio

log_indexes.why: RC1-451 the only log index. It shipped uncapped (daily_limit null, zero exclusion filters) against a baseline of ~265 indexed logs a day — the account's one unbounded spend. Capped at 20,000/day, ~40-75x headroom, with a warning at 80%.
